landing.documentTitle: Oubliepas — never miss a payment again
landing.title: You'll always know what's about to be charged.
landing.subtitle: Oubliepas brings your subscriptions and recurring bills together, works out what they cost you each month and warns you before the due date. Nothing is paid from the app: it tracks, it shows, it reminds.
landing.footnote: No bank connection. You enter what you track, nothing else.

pillars.togetherBody: Netflix, Spotify, iCloud on one side; rent, insurance, electricity on the other. Two kinds of expense, a single view.
pillars.costBody: Every line is converted to its monthly equivalent, whatever its frequency. The total stops being a surprise.
pillars.calendarBody: Month by month, what falls due and on which day. One tap marks a due date as paid.
pillars.remindersTitle: A reminder before every due date
pillars.remindersBody: Choose how many days ahead you want to be warned, line by line.
